about: The streamer registry's starting list: creators who publicly pay for or allow clipping (with the page that shows it), and big creators for whom no program was found (their clips never go to main accounts). Every entry is checked again every 7 days. Names, links and short quotes only. Edit freely: an entry needs name, status, checkedOn and, for "program", a proofUrl.
